FIRST_RUN_REPAIR.desc: Repair gear on each desktop's first visit after static.py starts. Turn off to skip it; repair still runs every REPAIR_INTERVAL seconds.

REPAIR_INTERVAL.desc: Seconds between repair passes. When it runs out, every desktop runs the repair the next time the loop reaches it.

VISIT_WAIT.desc: Pause at the end of each desktop visit before switching to the next one. 0 moves on straight away.

SERVICE_INTERVAL.desc: Per desktop: how often to do a service round — press Alt+P (bank + inventory), turn 10 dragonballs into a scroll and stash it, grab and equip arrows if there are none, deposit +N items through VIP > Compose, then close the inventory, bank and VIP menu. Between rounds a visit only checks for death.

F10_CYCLONE.desc: While hunting, press F10 (Cyclone) every 10 seconds on each desktop's game. It is pressed during the pause at the end of each visit (VISIT_WAIT), not while the bank or VIP menu is being used, and not while the character is dead.

ENABLED.desc: Run up to 4 game accounts, one per desktop (the first filled-in account on desktop 1, ...). When on, the script opens and logs into each account, logs back in after a crash, and turns on auto hunt. Needs the screen at 1920x1080 — at any other size this is turned off for that run with a warning, since the login screen can't be found. Passwords are stored encrypted for this Windows user only.

GAME_PATH.desc: The game's launcher (e.g. Play.exe). Used to open an account's game when its desktop has none running — at start and after a crash.

ACCOUNT_1_USER.label: Username
ACCOUNT_1_USER.desc: Game login username. This account runs on desktop 1. Leave empty to not use this slot.

ACCOUNT_1_PASS.label: Password
ACCOUNT_1_PASS.desc: Game login password. Saved encrypted — it is never shown again; type a new one to change it.

ACCOUNT_1_NAME.label: Character name
ACCOUNT_1_NAME.desc: The character's name exactly as it shows in the game chat. Needed for Kill reply and the double revive wait — it's how the script knows a kill message is about this account.

ACCOUNT_2_USER.label: Username
ACCOUNT_2_USER.desc: Game login username. This account runs on desktop 2. Leave empty to not use this slot.

ACCOUNT_2_PASS.label: Password
ACCOUNT_2_PASS.desc: Game login password. Saved encrypted — it is never shown again; type a new one to change it.

ACCOUNT_2_NAME.label: Character name
ACCOUNT_2_NAME.desc: The character's name exactly as it shows in the game chat. Needed for Kill reply and the double revive wait — it's how the script knows a kill message is about this account.

ACCOUNT_3_USER.label: Username
ACCOUNT_3_USER.desc: Game login username. This account runs on desktop 3. Leave empty to not use this slot.

ACCOUNT_3_PASS.label: Password
ACCOUNT_3_PASS.desc: Game login password. Saved encrypted — it is never shown again; type a new one to change it.

ACCOUNT_3_NAME.label: Character name
ACCOUNT_3_NAME.desc: The character's name exactly as it shows in the game chat. Needed for Kill reply and the double revive wait — it's how the script knows a kill message is about this account.

ACCOUNT_4_USER.label: Username
ACCOUNT_4_USER.desc: Game login username. This account runs on desktop 4. Leave empty to not use this slot.

ACCOUNT_4_PASS.label: Password
ACCOUNT_4_PASS.desc: Game login password. Saved encrypted — it is never shown again; type a new one to change it.

ACCOUNT_4_NAME.label: Character name
ACCOUNT_4_NAME.desc: The character's name exactly as it shows in the game chat. Needed for Kill reply and the double revive wait — it's how the script knows a kill message is about this account.

REVIVE_DELAY.desc: Per desktop: once an account is seen dead, wait this long before clicking Revive. Until then that desktop is skipped and the other desktops carry on as usual.

DOUBLE_REVIVE_WAIT.desc: If the same player kills an account twice in a row, wait twice REVIVE_DELAY before reviving it. Needs the account's character name (Accounts tab).

ENABLED.desc: When one of your accounts is killed, send the killer a chat message: their name in the chat bar's left box, a message in the right box, then Enter. Sent the next time the script visits that account's desktop. Kills are read from the game's chat (read-only); needs the account's character name (Accounts tab).

MESSAGES.default:
plz stop
enough plz
wtf
why killing me?!
MESSAGES.desc: One message per line — each reply picks one line at random. English letters, numbers and symbols only (it is typed on a US keyboard).

ENABLED.desc: Shows the last few console lines on top of the game while static.py runs. Turn off to hide the on-screen console. Clicks always pass through it to the game.

POSITION.desc: Where on the primary screen the on-screen console sits. Move it if it covers a part of the game the scripts need to see.

LINES.desc: How many of the most recent console lines are shown at once.

FONT_SIZE.desc: Text size of the on-screen console.

COLOR.desc: Text color of the on-screen console.

MARGIN.desc: Gap in pixels between the on-screen console and the edge of the screen.

ENABLED.desc: Keeps the grab-arrows and repair countdowns on screen while static.py runs. Turn off to hide them.

POSITION.desc: Where on the primary screen the countdowns sit. Keep it away from the on-screen console and from anything the scripts need to see.

MARGIN.desc: Gap in pixels between the countdowns and the edge of the screen.

ENABLED.desc: Turns the dragonball-to-scroll feature on: every loop, if the inventory has enough dragonballs, one is right-clicked to make a scroll, which is then Alt+clicked. Takes effect on the next loop, no restart needed.

MIN_COUNT.desc: How many dragonballs must be in the inventory before one is right-clicked to convert them into a scroll.

CONF_DB.desc: How closely an inventory slot must match dragonball.png to count as a dragonball. Empty slots score around 0.7, so keep this well above that.

CONF_SCROLL.desc: How closely an inventory slot must match dragonball_scroll.jpg to count as the new scroll. Lower it if the scroll isn't recognized after converting.
